verdict.rationale: Pylon documents an official Pylon MCP Server that exposes its data to MCP-capable AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor [pylon-docs-37, pylon-probe-4]. It authenticates via OAuth and can read and update issues, accounts and contacts within the user's permissions [pylon-docs-34], and the bring-your-own-agent docs name Pylon MCP as a way to connect agents to ticketing workflows [pylon-docs-16]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of the tool list and setup steps.
